# TranslateNote

> An Obsidian plugin that translates a selection or a whole note with any OpenAI-compatible LLM, and shows the result in a side panel so it can be read against the original before it touches the note.

TranslateNote lets you translate articles, notes, or web clippings into any language directly inside Obsidian, using your own LLM API key.
The translation opens in a side panel with Insert and Discard: the note is not modified until the reader accepts it, and the text can be edited in the panel first.
Full-note translation leaves the YAML front-matter untouched, and an insert is refused if the note changed while it was being reviewed.
The target language is a free-text field rather than a fixed list, and the system prompt is editable.
Eight provider presets — DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, Kimi (Moonshot), Qwen, Z.AI, OpenRouter, plus Custom — all point at globally reachable endpoints.
